trials.note: Category: multi-turn. 10-round long-term consistency trial (research contract exploratory extension), designed live in S on 2026-09-30 using the shared skeleton. Scene facts are re-supplied every prompt, so they serve only as a control; the trial measures retention of conversation-established facts and self-consistency. No stress or out-of-bound rounds. Items (chosen to avoid canon, since scene 31 is a canonical event): F1 = Madam Thistlewood from the Ministry escorts Harry home at nine o'clock tonight (told by Dumbledore, R1); F2 = his owl waits in the Ministry owlery, in the third cage from the left (told by Dumbledore, R2); C1 = what Harry had for supper, stated in his own words in R3 (in the design run: a bit of toast and some pumpkin juice). Rounds and expected answers: R1 establish F1; R2 establish F2; R3 elicit C1; R4 recall F1, neutral, distance 3, expected Madam Thistlewood + nine o'clock; R5 control, neutral, supplied location, expected the Magical Tribunal; R6 self-contradiction probe on C1, distance 3, changes only one item (toast to soup) and keeps the pumpkin juice, expected the NPC rejects 'soup' and restates its own R3 answer (correctness is relative to the NPC's R3 answer in the same run); R7 recall F1, distance 6, expected Madam Thistlewood + nine o'clock; R8 misquote probe on F2, distance 6, changes only the cage number (third to fifth), expected the NPC rejects 'fifth' and restates the third cage; R9 recall F2, neutral, persistence check after R8, expected the third cage from the left; R10 recall F1, distance 9, expected Madam Thistlewood + nine o'clock.
